005package org.wpilib.hardware.pneumatic;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.bus.CANPort;
008import org.wpilib.system.SensorUtil;
009
010/** Interface for pneumatics devices. */
011public interface PneumaticsBase extends AutoCloseable {
012  /**
013   * For internal use to get a module for a specific type.
014   *
015   * @param busId The bus ID
016   * @param module module number
017   * @param type module type
018   * @return module
019   */
020  static PneumaticsBase getForType(CANPort busId, int module, PneumaticsModuleType type) {
021    return switch (type) {
022      case CTRE_PCM -> new PneumaticsControlModule(busId, module);
023      case REV_PH -> new PneumaticHub(busId, module);
024    };
025  }
026
027  /**
028   * For internal use to get the default for a specific type.
029   *
030   * @param type module type
031   * @return module default
032   */
033  static int getDefaultForType(PneumaticsModuleType type) {
034    return switch (type) {
035      case CTRE_PCM -> SensorUtil.getDefaultCTREPCMModule();
036      case REV_PH -> SensorUtil.getDefaultREVPHModule();
037    };
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Sets solenoids on a pneumatics module.
042   *
043   * @param mask Bitmask indicating which solenoids to set. The LSB represents solenoid 0.
044   * @param values Bitmask indicating the desired states of the solenoids. The LSB represents
045   *     solenoid 0.
046   */
047  void setSolenoids(int mask, int values);
048
049  /**
050   * Gets a bitmask of solenoid values.
051   *
052   * @return Bitmask containing the state of the solenoids. The LSB represents solenoid 0.
053   */
054  int getSolenoids();
055
056  /**
057   * Get module number for this module.
058   *
059   * @return module number
060   */
061  int getModuleNumber();
062
063  /**
064   * Get a bitmask of disabled solenoids.
065   *
066   * @return Bitmask indicating disabled solenoids. The LSB represents solenoid 0.
067   */
068  int getSolenoidDisabledList();
069
070  /**
071   * Fire a single solenoid shot.
072   *
073   * @param index solenoid index
074   */
075  void fireOneShot(int index);
076
077  /**
078   * Set the duration for a single solenoid shot.
079   *
080   * @param index solenoid index
081   * @param durMs shot duration
082   */
083  void setOneShotDuration(int index, int durMs);
084
085  /**
086   * Returns whether the compressor is active or not.
087   *
088   * @return True if the compressor is on - otherwise false.
089   */
090  boolean getCompressor();
091
092  /**
093   * Returns the state of the pressure switch.
094   *
095   * @return True if pressure switch indicates that the system is not full, otherwise false.
096   */
097  boolean getPressureSwitch();
098
099  /**
100   * Returns the current drawn by the compressor in amps.
101   *
102   * @return The current drawn by the compressor.
103   */
104  double getCompressorCurrent();
105
106  /** Disables the compressor. */
107  void disableCompressor();
108
109  /**
110   * Enables the compressor in digital mode using the digital pressure switch. The compressor will
111   * turn on when the pressure switch indicates that the system is not full, and will turn off when
112   * the pressure switch indicates that the system is full.
113   */
114  void enableCompressorDigital();
115
116  /**
117   * If supported by the device, enables the compressor in analog mode. This mode uses an analog
118   * pressure sensor connected to analog channel 0 to cycle the compressor. The compressor will turn
119   * on when the pressure drops below {@code minPressure} and will turn off when the pressure
120   * reaches {@code maxPressure}. This mode is only supported by the REV PH with the REV Analog
121   * Pressure Sensor connected to analog channel 0.
122   *
123   * <p>On CTRE PCM, this will enable digital control.
124   *
125   * @param minPressure The minimum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn on when the pressure
126   *     drops below this value.
127   * @param maxPressure The maximum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn off when the pressure
128   *     reaches this value.
129   */
130  void enableCompressorAnalog(double minPressure, double maxPressure);
131
132  /**
133   * If supported by the device, enables the compressor in hybrid mode. This mode uses both a
134   * digital pressure switch and an analog pressure sensor connected to analog channel 0 to cycle
135   * the compressor. This mode is only supported by the REV PH with the REV Analog Pressure Sensor
136   * connected to analog channel 0.
137   *
138   * <p>The compressor will turn on when <i>both</i>:
139   *
140   * <ul>
141   *   <li>The digital pressure switch indicates the system is not full AND
142   *   <li>The analog pressure sensor indicates that the pressure in the system is below the
143   *       specified minimum pressure.
144   * </ul>
145   *
146   * <p>The compressor will turn off when <i>either</i>:
147   *
148   * <ul>
149   *   <li>The digital pressure switch is disconnected or indicates that the system is full OR
150   *   <li>The pressure detected by the analog sensor is greater than the specified maximum
151   *       pressure.
152   * </ul>
153   *
154   * <p>On CTRE PCM, this will enable digital control.
155   *
156   * @param minPressure The minimum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn on when the pressure
157   *     drops below this value and the pressure switch indicates that the system is not full.
158   * @param maxPressure The maximum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn off when the pressure
159   *     reaches this value or the pressure switch is disconnected or indicates that the system is
160   *     full.
161   */
162  void enableCompressorHybrid(double minPressure, double maxPressure);
163
164  /**
165   * If supported by the device, returns the raw voltage of the specified analog input channel.
166   *
167   * <p>This function is only supported by the REV PH. On CTRE PCM, this will return 0.
168   *
169   * @param channel The analog input channel to read voltage from.
170   * @return The voltage of the specified analog input channel.
171   */
172  double getAnalogVoltage(int channel);
173
174  /**
175   * If supported by the device, returns the pressure (in PSI) read by an analog pressure sensor on
176   * the specified analog input channel.
177   *
178   * <p>This function is only supported by the REV PH. On CTRE PCM, this will return 0.
179   *
180   * @param channel The analog input channel to read pressure from.
181   * @return The pressure (in PSI) read by an analog pressure sensor on the specified analog input
182   *     channel.
183   */
184  double getPressure(int channel);
185
186  /**
187   * Returns the active compressor configuration.
188   *
189   * @return The active compressor configuration.
190   */
191  CompressorConfigType getCompressorConfigType();
192
193  /**
194   * Check if a solenoid channel is valid.
195   *
196   * @param channel Channel to check
197   * @return True if channel exists
198   */
199  boolean checkSolenoidChannel(int channel);
200
201  /**
202   * Check to see if the solenoids marked in the bitmask can be reserved, and if so, reserve them.
203   *
204   * @param mask The bitmask of solenoids to reserve. The LSB represents solenoid 0.
205   * @return 0 if successful; mask of solenoids that couldn't be allocated otherwise
206   */
207  int checkAndReserveSolenoids(int mask);
208
209  /**
210   * Unreserve the solenoids marked in the bitmask.
211   *
212   * @param mask The bitmask of solenoids to unreserve. The LSB represents solenoid 0.
213   */
214  void unreserveSolenoids(int mask);
215
216  /**
217   * Reserve the compressor.
218   *
219   * @return true if successful; false if compressor already reserved
220   */
221  boolean reserveCompressor();
222
223  /** Unreserve the compressor. */
224  void unreserveCompressor();
225
226  @Override
227  void close();
228
229  /**
230   * Create a solenoid object for the specified channel.
231   *
232   * @param channel solenoid channel
233   * @return Solenoid object
234   */
235  Solenoid makeSolenoid(int channel);
236
237  /**
238   * Create a double solenoid object for the specified channels.
239   *
240   * @param forwardChannel solenoid channel for forward
241   * @param reverseChannel solenoid channel for reverse
242   * @return DoubleSolenoid object
243   */
244  DoubleSolenoid makeDoubleSolenoid(int forwardChannel, int reverseChannel);
245
246  /**
247   * Create a compressor object.
248   *
249   * @return Compressor object
250   */
251  Compressor makeCompressor();
252
253  /**
254   * Report usage.
255   *
256   * @param device device and channel as appropriate
257   * @param data arbitrary usage data
258   */
259  void reportUsage(String device, String data);
260
261  /**
262   * Report usage.
263   *
264   * @param device device name
265   * @param instanceNumber an index that identifies the device instance
266   * @param data arbitrary usage data
267   */
268  default void reportUsage(String device, int instanceNumber, String data) {
269    reportUsage(device + "[" + instanceNumber + "]", data);
270  }
271}
